//: metiche pointed at itself. Agents working ON metiche coordinate THROUGH metiche.
There is no credential in this file and there must never be one. The join
code is supplied by the environment: ${METICHE_TOKEN} is expanded when
this config is loaded. Put it in your own dotfiles, never here —
install.sh writes ~/.metiche/env (mode 0600) and prints the one line that
loads it from your shell profile. ${METICHE_MCP_URL} overrides the endpoint
mcp.metiche.xyz is live. The bearer is the TOKEN the installer obtained
for you, never a join code -- a join code is an invite you redeem once,
and the server answers 401 if you send one as a credential.
